none: PAS CAM-F81523: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD 367-383
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA RO-MANORVM ; D/ [DN GR]ATIA-[NVS P F AVG]

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD 367-383 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA RO-MANORVM. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, dragging captive and holing labarum. Mint is Aquileia. See LRBC p.67, no.1019. Obverse legend reads [DN GR]ATIA-[NVS P F AVG]. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //(dot)SMAQP. Die axis is 6…
